budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library reported it was 37% expended, one half through the fiscal year, with Kanopy and some Digital Services expenses coming up.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board asked about the 82% expended office supply figure; the director attributed it to a one-time laptop expense.
budget_items.quote: harry asked about the 82% expended office supply figure. muir said there was a one-time expense for a laptop.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The director estimated the fine-free policy has reduced revenue slightly, with some expenses incurred for tracking materials and notifications.
budget_items.quote: muir said we are probably a few hundred dollars down.

budget_items.quote: the town received $3.5 million in arpa funds from the federal government.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board discussed HVAC replacement as a capital need and the director was to write an ARPA proposal; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: capital needs: we should be looking at the replacement of the hvac system.
